A.text: Doctors can use the very insoluble $\text{MgSO}_4$ to investigate the digestive system.

B.text: Farmers can lower the pH of soil by spreading $\text{CaCO}_3$ on it.

C.text: Students can test a solution for $\text{SO}_4^{2-}$ ions by using $\text{Ba(NO}_3\text{)}_2\text{(aq)}$ followed by $\text{HNO}_3\text{(aq)}$.

D.text: The insoluble hydroxide, $\text{Ba(OH)}_2$, can be safely used to lower the acidity of the stomach.
